description: Starts immediately unless the recruited crowd is wrong (more than 1 in 5 not the requested audience); the result includes the audience summary, examples and fit. Only a wrong crowd returns audience_review: show the warning, then use review_id, confirm_audience and audience_fit_acknowledged to continue, or audience_correction to recruit again. Send simulated people through a multi-step flow (signup, onboarding, checkout) in a real browser, clicking and typing, to find the step where they get stuck or give up. Slower than test_page, and each person uses 5 credits. Returns each person's steps, where they stopped and why.

audience.description: Who the simulated people should be, in plain words, e.g. "startup founders in SF" or "parents shopping for kids toys". If omitted, Mimiq picks the likely audience from the content.

audience_correction.description: Not quite? Change who and rerun: use with review_id. Recruits a new crowd under the existing credit rules; starts unless the new crowd is wrong, otherwise returns a new review.

audience_fit_acknowledged.description: Set only after telling the user about an audience-fit warning and they choose to continue.

confirm_audience.description: Start with the reviewed people after showing them to the user.

count.description: How many simulated people (default 5, max 10; without a key a free flow has up to 3, and defaults to 3). Each runs a full browser session and uses 5 credits.

goal.description: The task each person tries, e.g. "complete the signup and reach the dashboard". Default: sign up and start using it.

max_steps.description: Optional step limit per person (10 to 60). The server defaults to 40.

review_id.description: The review_id from a low-fit review or completed/running result. Bound to this URL and test kind.

url.description: Where the flow starts. Must be publicly reachable. For localhost, open a cloudflared tunnel and pass the tunnel URL.
